question: According to the GSEs' August 2024 PMIERs update (Guidance 2024-01), what is the implementation phase-in schedule, and what substantive change does it make to the PMIERs standards?
expected_answer: The August 21, 2024 PMIERs update refined the Available Assets definition by introducing new investment-risk deductions based on asset class and credit rating (more granular bond credit-quality and liquidity tiers) and establishing new limits on assets backed by residential mortgages or commercial real estate. The phase-in is over 24 months: 25% effective March 31, 2025; 50% effective September 30, 2025; 75% effective March 31, 2026; and 100% effective September 30, 2026. Separately, the COVID-19 Disaster Related Capital Charge for COVID-19 Defaulted Loans was eliminated effective March 31, 2025.
agent_answer:
**Implementation phase-in schedule (Guidance 2024-01)**

| Quarter ending | Add-back from prior framework | Phase-in of new rules |
|---|---|---|
| March 31, 2025 & June 30, 2025 | 75% | 25% |
| September 30, 2025 & December 31, 2025 | 50% | 50% |
| March 31, 2026 & June 30, 2026 | 25% | 75% |
| September 30, 2026 onward | 0% | 100% |

At each milestone, the insurer calculates its Available Assets under both the old and new rules; the "add-back" percentage of the difference is applied so that the impact phases in gradually. Full adoption is required by September 30, 2026, at which point Guidance 2024-01 will be incorporated into the next published PMIERs base text.

**Substantive change** — The guidance amends Section 703 (Available Assets) to tighten **bond eligibility and haircuts**:

- Bonds must be rated by one of six agencies (S&P, Moody's, Fitch, A.M. Best, DBRS, or KBRA); unrated bonds are ineligible.
- A new haircut table: 0% for full-faith-and-credit U.S. government securities, 0.20% for AAA, scaling up to 10.00% for BB+ to BB− / 25.00% for B+ to B− (with term caps), and 100% for CCC+ and below.
- **New exclusions**: mortgage insurance-linked notes (MILNs), all non-agency RMBS, bonds rated CCC+ or below, BB-rated bonds over 5-year term, and B-rated bonds over 2-year term.
- **New concentration limits**: GSE debt/MBS ≤ 25% of Available Assets; ABS ≤ 20%; sub-investment-grade bonds + common/preferred shares aggregate ≤ 5%; non-agency CMBS ≤ 5%; surplus notes capped at 9% of Minimum Required Assets; COLI ≤ 10% of the risk-based required asset amount.
rationale: Phase-in schedule and substantive changes to bond eligibility, haircuts, exclusions, and concentration limits align with expected answer.
